currentOfficial.label: 85 seconds to midnight
currentOfficial.note: Official annual baseline used as an anchor for the live model. The app's live timer can move around this baseline as news risk changes.

timeline.label: 7 minutes
timeline.context: Initial Clock setting after World War II.

timeline.label: 3 minutes

timeline.label: 2 minutes

timeline.label: 12 minutes

timeline.label: 3 minutes
timeline.context: US-Soviet arms race and communication breakdown raise danger.

timeline.label: 17 minutes
timeline.context: Cold War ends and major nuclear arms reductions begin.

timeline.label: 5 minutes
timeline.context: Climate change joins nuclear weapons as a major Clock driver.

timeline.label: 2 minutes
timeline.context: Nuclear tensions and information threats worsen.

timeline.label: 100 seconds
timeline.context: Nuclear risk, climate inaction, and cyber-enabled disinformation converge.

timeline.label: 90 seconds
timeline.context: Russia-Ukraine war and nuclear escalation risks move the Clock closer.

timeline.label: 89 seconds
timeline.context: Official Clock reaches its closest point at that time.

timeline.label: 85 seconds
timeline.context: Official Clock baseline moves closer amid nuclear, climate, biological, AI, and information risks.

badHumanityDays.title: Atomic bombing of Hiroshima
badHumanityDays.summary: First wartime use of a nuclear weapon demonstrated civilization-scale destructive power.

badHumanityDays.title: First Soviet atomic bomb test
badHumanityDays.summary: Started a bipolar nuclear arms race and moved the official Clock sharply toward midnight.

badHumanityDays.title: Cuban Missile Crisis begins
badHumanityDays.summary: The world entered one of the highest-risk nuclear confrontations in history.

badHumanityDays.title: Chernobyl nuclear disaster
badHumanityDays.summary: A catastrophic reactor accident spread long-term radiological, political, and public-health consequences.

badHumanityDays.title: September 11 attacks
badHumanityDays.summary: Mass-casualty terrorism reshaped global security policy and conflict dynamics.

badHumanityDays.title: COVID-19 declared a pandemic
badHumanityDays.summary: A global biological crisis exposed fragility in health, governance, and supply-chain systems.

badHumanityDays.title: Russia launches full-scale invasion of Ukraine
badHumanityDays.summary: A major interstate war revived direct nuclear escalation risks in Europe.

badHumanityDays.title: Hottest global day cluster recorded
badHumanityDays.summary: Extreme global heat underscored accelerating climate-system stress.
